description: Session-context functions that only shape-stable assertions can pin across backends: CURRENT_SESSION identifies the session with a non-empty value, CURRENT_STATEMENT echoes the running SQL so its own text appears in the answer, CURRENT_SECONDARY_ROLES reports a JSON shape carrying a roles member, and LAST_TRANSACTION reports an id after an explicit COMMIT. Converted 1:1 from functions/SessionContextGapsTest (now retired); the Java read every value through String.valueOf and then compared against the text "null", which a SQL NULL would also satisfy, so the converted tests use IS NOT NULL and LENGTH checks instead.

steps.sql: SELECT CURRENT_SESSION() IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(CURRENT_SESSION()) > 0
